meta.source: Prydwen.gg NIKKE 가이드(Team Building, Meta Teams - Story/Tribe Tower, Teams Database, Tier List 변경 이력) 및 니케 위키를 참고해 정리한 2차 자료. 원문을 그대로 인용하지 않고 우리말로 재구성/요약함. 캐릭터 이름은 데이터베이스(characterDatabase.json)의 title/name_kr 기준. 2026-07-31부터는 사용자가 지정한 니케 유튜버 4인(고뇨/스페란도/에펜바움/김진서)의 최근 영상 내용도 1순위 자료로 반영.
meta.updateNote: 새 공략/패치 정보를 확인할 때마다 archetypes, synergyPairs, counters 배열에 계속 항목을 추가해 나갈 것. 이 파일은 조합 추천 스코어링 엔진의 '근거 자료'로 쓰인다. 2026-07-31: 7/23 패치(신규 유닛 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로, 맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉 출시)와 관련해 스페란도(유튜버) 영상들에서 반복적으로 소개된 PVP 조합을 1건 추가함(archetypes 'laplace-maxwell-pip-deck', synergyPairs 마지막 항목). 국내 유튜버 1개 채널 기준 정보라 추가 확인 필요. 2026-08-04: 주간 조사 결과 반영 — archetypes에 'wind-laplace-maxwell'(풍라플/풍맥덱, 스페란도 출처, 맥스웰 기여도에 대한 이견 있음), 'swha-alt-marciana'(마르차나: 마린 스터디를 스노우화이트: 헤비암즈 대체픽으로 활용, 김진서 출처) 2건 추가. 기존 'laplace-maxwell-pip-deck'(피뻥덱)과는 별개의 조합임.

burstPhase.rule: 버스트 게이지는 I -> II -> III 순서로만 진행된다. 각 단계에서 10초 안에 해당 버스트 타입 캐릭터가 스킬을 쓰지 않으면 게이지가 처음부터 다시 쌓인다. 팀에 버스트 I/II/III가 각각 최소 1명씩 없으면 풀버스트(4단계)에 도달할 수 없다.
burstPhase.implication: 5인 조합을 짤 때 버스트 I/II/III 세 타입이 모두 포함돼야 한다는 것은 취향이 아니라 강제 규칙. 스코어링에서 이 조건 미충족 시 크게 감점(사실상 탈락)해야 함.

autoSkillOrder.rule: 오토스킬(자동전투) 사용 시, 왼쪽부터 오른쪽 순서로 버스트I -> II -> III 캐릭터를 각각 한 명씩 찾아 스킬을 사용한다. 같은 타입이 여러 명이면 왼쪽에 배치된 캐릭터가 우선 사용되고, 쿨타임/사망/스턴 상태면 다음 순번으로 넘어간다.
autoSkillOrder.implication: 같은 버스트 타입이 팀에 2명 이상 있을 때는 배치 순서와 쿨타임 조합이 실제 발동 캐릭터를 결정한다. 상세 배치 최적화는 향후 고도화 대상.

burstSkillCooldown.rule: 버스트 스킬 쿨타임은 캐릭터마다 다르며 보통 20초 또는 40초. 쿨타임이 짧을수록(20초) 풀버스트 진입 빈도가 높아진다.
burstSkillCooldown.implication: 버스트 I/II 캐릭터는 쿨타임 20초 여부가 '풀버스트 안정성' 점수의 핵심 요소. characterDatabase.json의 skills[].cd 값을 그대로 활용 가능.

cdr.concept: CDR(Cooldown Reduction, 쿨타임 감소)은 아군 버스트/스킬 쿨타임을 줄여주는 효과로, 풀버스트 사이클 속도를 좌우하는 핵심 자원. 기본공격 트리거형(D: 킬러 와이프, 루주), 버스트 트리거형(솔린: 프로스트 티켓, 도로시) 등 발동 조건이 캐릭터마다 다름.
cdr.implication: 팀에 CDR 제공 캐릭터가 최소 1명 있는지가 고티어 조합의 필수 조건 중 하나로 자주 언급됨. 스코어링에서 CDR 보유 여부를 가산 요소로 넣을 것.

formations.2-1-2: 버스트I 2명 + 버스트II 1명 + 버스트III 2명. 유연하고 안정적이며 초반/자원이 부족할 때 기본형. 특정 무기 특화 조합에도 적합(서포터가 더 필요하므로).
formations.1-1-3: 버스트I 1명 + 버스트II 1명 + 버스트III 3명. 화력은 극대화되지만 버스트I/II가 최상급이 아니면 생존력이 부족해짐. 고investment 팀에 적합.

elementCycle.rule: 물이 불에게, 불이 바람에게, 바람이 철에게, 철이 전기에게, 전기가 물에게 상성 우위(피해량 +10%)를 가지는 순환 구조. 상성 보너스는 10%로 비교적 작아서 버스트 궁합/CDR/역할 구성보다 우선순위가 낮음.
elementCycle.implication: 스코어링에서 원소 상성은 가벼운 보너스 가중치로만 반영하고, 절대적 기준으로 삼지 않을 것.

archetypes.name: 베스갓(베스티: 택티컬 업그레이드 원맨아미)
archetypes.note: 버스트/논버스트, 버퍼 유무와 상관없이 혼자서 캠페인을 밀어붙일 수 있는 원맨아미형 캐릭터. 방어력 무시 데미지가 핵심이라 고디시트(페널티) 구간에서 특히 강력.

archetypes.name: 라피: 레드 후드 원맨아미
archetypes.note: 단일 타겟/광역 모두 강력한 원맨아미형 딜러. 버스트I 쿨감 역할도 겸할 수 있음. 프레임 드랍 시 성능이 급락하는 단점.

archetypes.name: 홍련: 흑영(SBS) 원맨아미
archetypes.note: 저페널티 구간 최강 화면 클리어형 캐릭터. 한 타겟을 맞히면 화면 전체가 정리되는 광역 전이 효과가 핵심.

archetypes.name: 스노우 화이트: 헤비암즈 원맨아미
archetypes.note: 60프레임 안정적으로 유지 가능하면 어떤 버스트I/II를 데려가도 스토리를 밀 수 있는 화력형 캐릭터.

archetypes.name: 안니스: 스타 솔로캐리
archetypes.note: 버스트I 혼자서 딜/버프/쿨감/버스트 게이지 생성을 모두 담당해 버스트II·III 티어에 구애받지 않고 캐리 가능.

archetypes.name: 민트카(민트+프리카)
archetypes.note: 강력한 버프 듀오. 다만 실드/1차 풀버스트 화력이 약해 두 캐릭터가 세트로 묶여야만 제 성능이 나오는 경직적인 조합. 버스트I로 안니스: 스파클링 서머를 쓰면 시너지가 배가됨.

archetypes.name: 엘마초(마스트: 로망틱 메이드+앵커: 이노센트 메이드)
archetypes.note: 무조건적인 강력한 버프 + 튼튼한 힐 + 재장전 속도 증가로 구 메타였던 블랑+누아르 조합을 완전히 대체함. 캠페인 보스 상대로 앵커의 HP 저장(스토리지) 효과와 궁합이 좋음.

archetypes.name: 티아+나가
archetypes.note: 미시리스 소속 스쿨걸 듀오. 딜러 궁합을 크게 타지 않아 어떤 버스트III를 데려가도 무난하게 작동. 버스트I이 한 명 더 필요하다는 게 유일한 제약.

archetypes.name: 크라운(+티아+나가 대체)
archetypes.note: 크라운은 '티아+나가' 아키타입의 상위호환이자 대체재입니다 — 같은 역할(버스트II 코어)을 더 잘 수행하므로, 크라운을 보유하고 있다면 이 조합에 티아+나가를 추가로 넣지 마세요. 특히 나가는 버스트II를 크라운이 담당하게 되면 자신의 버스트 스킬(쿨타임 20초, 크라운과 동일)이 실제로 발동할 타이밍을 얻지 못해 토템(1/2스킬 상시 효과만 남는 역할)으로 전환되는데, 이 경우 나가와의 궁합에만 의존하는 티아를 넣을 근거도 함께 사라집니다. 티아+나가는 크라운이 로스터에 없을 때만 대신 채택하는 조합입니다.

archetypes.name: 이자벨+아르카나 전기/철 보스전 코어
archetypes.note: 안니스: 스타, 신데렐라/신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브와 함께 전기 약점/철 약점 보스전에서 핵심 조합으로 꼽히는 페어.

archetypes.name: 나가는 신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브 전용
archetypes.note: 나가는 코어 데미지 증뎁이라 스킬뎀 위주인 스노우화이트/SBS 등과는 궁합이 나쁘고, 코어뎀 스케일링하는 신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브와 조합했을 때만 진가를 발휘함.

archetypes.name: 즈바이(트레저)+민트
archetypes.note: 즈바이 트레저의 약점(크리티컬 확률/피해 부족)을 민트의 버프가 정확히 보완해줘서 최상급 페어링으로 평가됨.

archetypes.name: 델타: 닌자시프+크라운
archetypes.note: 델타가 받는피해 증가 디버프를 걸어 크라운의 S2를 반복 발동시키는 연계.

archetypes.name: 택티컬 엠마+택티컬 은화
archetypes.note: 고정 데미지(참데미지) 버프를 주고받는 듀오. 혼자서는 약하지만 둘이 묶이면 베스티: 택티컬 업그레이드와 함께 PvP에서 순간 폭딜을 낼 수 있음.

archetypes.name: 베스갓의 바람 속성 카운터
archetypes.note: PvP에서 방어 무시 데미지 때문에 바람 속성 캐릭터들이 특히 쉽게 저격당함(레이 아야나미: 잠정판, 홍련 등이 취약 사례로 언급).

archetypes.name: 불멸(인돔) 캐릭터군의 즉사기 카운터
archetypes.note: PvP에서 즉사급 버스트 데미지를 막는 핵심 수단이 이 캐릭터들의 무적/불멸 효과. 이들을 상대하려면 지연발동 공격이나 무적 관통 수단이 필요.

archetypes.name: 2RL 인스턴트 누크(홍련+레드후드B1+트리나)
archetypes.note: 레드후드B1의 공격력 버프와 트리나의 버프를 홍련에게 몰아줘서 상대가 대응하기 전에 순삭시키는 PvP 초반 러시형 조합. RL(로켓런처) 무기가 2번 발사하면 버스트 게이지가 가득 차는 특성을 활용.

archetypes.name: 피뻥덱(라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로+맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉+루주+트리나)
archetypes.note: 2026년 7월 23일 신규 유닛 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로/맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉 출시 직후, 국내 니케 유튜버(스페란도)가 여러 영상에서 반복 소개한 PVP 즉발 폭딜 조합. 라플라스가 순간 폭딜을 내고 맥스웰의 최대체력 버프가 생존력을 보강하는 형태로 추정. 국내 유튜버 1개 채널 기준 정보라 스킬작/오버로드 세부 구성은 추가 확인이 필요함(2026-07-31 기준).

archetypes.name: 풍라플/풍맥덱(라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로+맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉+트리나)
archetypes.note: 2026년 8월 시점 조사. 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로를 축으로 맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉을 서브 파츠로 넣는 풍압 속성 보스전 조합. 다만 맥스웰의 실제 기여도(엄폐물 회복 버프가 나가+티아 조합과 상충한다는 지적 있음)에 대한 평가가 유튜버 간에 갈려 필수픽으로 단정하기는 이름. 이사카나로 맥스웰을 대체하는 조합도 대안으로 거론됨(출처: 스페란도).

archetypes.name: 스노우 화이트: 헤비암즈 대체 조합(마르차나: 마린 스터디)
archetypes.note: 2026년 7월 출시 신캐 마르차나: 마린 스터디를 기존 스노우 화이트: 헤비암즈 자리의 대체픽으로 활용하는 조합(출처: 김진서). 재장전 시 탄환 2배 + 공격력 대폭 증가 스킬 구조가 핵심으로 언급됨(출처: 고뇨).

archetypes.name: 오토팀(초심자용 밸런스 조합)
archetypes.note: 힐/공격버프/쿨감이 고루 섞인 무난한 자동전투용 조합. 베스티/라피 대신 신데렐라나 홍련: 흑영, 모더니아로 대체 가능하고 리터 대신 페퍼(쿨감은 없지만 강한 힐)나 D:킬러와이프/루주(기본공격 트리거 쿨감)로 대체 가능.

archetypes.name: 엘리시온 타워 추천 조합
archetypes.note: 광역 화력(라피/베스티)에 헬름 트레저의 힐, 앵커의 HP 저장 버프가 더해진 자동전투 특화 조합.

archetypes.name: 미시리스 타워 추천 조합
archetypes.note: 리터-티아-나가 '삼위일체' 코어에 나머지 2딜러는 스테이지별로 교체(아인/라플라스, 혹은 드레이크 트레저/퀀시: 에스케이프 퀸). 참고: 2026-07-31 기준 국내 유튜버(김진서)는 신규 유닛 맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉이 미시리스 타워 콘텐츠 정상화의 핵심이라고 평가함 - 구성 개편 여부는 추가 확인 필요.

archetypes.name: 필그림 타워 추천 조합
archetypes.note: 단일 타겟 화력, 광역 정리력, 쿨감이 모두 뛰어난 조합으로 5원소가 골고루 섞여 원소 방벽에 안 막히는 게 특징. 라피를 버스트I으로 돌리면 버스트III 딜러 슬롯을 하나 더 확보 가능.

archetypes.name: 크라켄전 크라운+마스트 로테이션

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapi
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A very basic team for Campaign. Rapi provides high single target and AoE DPS, while Mod and Helm are used according to the situation. Since both of the Fire DPS are MG units, they can hunt down any rapture with ease because MG units can easily lock on to core. If you need AoE support, burst with Modernia, but otherwise just burst with HelmT to ensure the team lives through anything. If your Modernia is not well built, but your Rapi has great OL gear, you may sub her out for Naga. This way, you basically funnel all buffs into Rapi and allow her to showcase why she is the best unit in the game. This team is usable accross any element! Substitutions: HelmT can be replaced with Maid Mast or Naga if Siren is B1. Siren may be replaced by other B1-CDR units if HelmT is in the team for burst generation. Modernia can be replaced by Naga if you have a well invested Rapi.

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Solohood (CDR + RH Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A very strong contender for the easiest to use Campaign team for players who prefer bossing modes over others, and are not looking to invest into the likes of VestiTU for example. Red Hood's burst generation ensures that the team can get to next burst before Siren's cooldown time. Not just that, but the addition of HelmT as a B3 support means you can do a special combo for players looking to push into higher deficits. While for the first few bursts you would be following the usual pattern of RRH->RH->RRH.., you can break this pattern by bursting with Helm once to heal the team to full (especially useful against Bronchus (farter)), and then using RH-B1 with Rapi's B3 to deal devestating damage to the final boss of the stage. This ensures that the team doesn't die to chip damage and confirms the kill. Substitutions: -

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Alice
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A fully built Alice is a beast for Fire-Weak campaign. She scales well with basically every buffer, but this specific combo of Alice paired with Rapi has everything: Burst Generation with Alice, Helm and Siren, AoE Damage with Rapi and Alice's pierce, Single Target Focus DPS with Alice piercing through shields even! A very strong team and probably the best if not the best if not for Vesti's AoE being so useful in later stages where clearing a few small mobs such as Volleyballs becomes a neccessity. HelmT can even be replaced with Red-Hood or Maid Mast for making use of ATK buffs to counter higher CP Deficits! Substitutions: HelmT can be replaced with Maid Mast for her reload and ATK buffs, or Red-Hood for her B1 stage. Siren may be replaced with any other B1-CDR if you do not have her yet. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Asupi (CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Asuka is a strong DPS for fire, especially for stages without any shielders. No shields = no one to stop Asuka's teammates from making use of Asuka's core damage bonus for fire allies. Even if there are shields, Asuka deals higher damage to them, making them break early allowing for faster wave clearing. Not to mention, she can even hit raptures through shields thanks to her pierce! Substitutions: HelmT may be replaced with Red Hood's B1 or Maid Mast. Make sure at least one burst gen assist unit is in the team before replacing Siren for another CDR. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Asulice (Rapi as B1)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Well, we've seen enough about Rapi B3. It is now time to discuss Rapi as B1. Rapi doesn't buff a lot as B1, but she really doesn't need to considering the damage she dishes out. A manaul intensive Alice for burst generation gets all the assist she needs from Asuka and Rapi that she needs to ensure that the stage is cleared! Fire mains can try using this team to achieve high deficit clears for the leaderboards. With both main B3s and the B1 being core focused units (with the B3s having pierce as well), Naga can also assist this team well. ATK buffs and reload speed from Maid Mast also allow for heavily improved DPS. Substitutions: HelmT may be replaced with Maid Mast, Naga or RH-B1. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Breeze-ing Through Campaign ft. SBLice (RRH CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] For Low deficit players, there is nothing better than a good SBS! And who better to pair her with than Alice! Alice provides the single target focus damage that SBS does not have while there is a large number of mobs on the screen. Meanwhile, SBS with elemental damage is simply.. lovely! 2+ years since her release, and she is still probably the best low deficit DPS to exist in Nikke, even with all the new tech we have with units like Rapi etc. But who says no to using Rapi? If you lack Siren, just use Rapi to cover all your bases for wind weak content! She will assist not only Alice in focus target DPS, but also SBS by doing chip damage to mobs. All is well and easy in low deficit as long as you have SBS. You may take advantage of Maid Mast's Distributed Damage and ATK buffs to further buff your Scarlet, provided that you are able to properly burst gen with Alice. Substitutions: HelmT may be replaced by Maid Mast.

archetypes.name: Zap-ping Through Campaign ft. Cindy & Ein (CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team consists of Ein, who is a strong AoE mobber in Campaign especially at High Deficit thanks to her True Damage. Rapi: Red Hood is used as the other B3 because there is no other Electric B3 yet that can fill this role better (Red Hood & Alice come close). HelmTr is used to activate Crown's S2 and provide emergency heal on Burst if needed. Siren is used as CDR. Substitutions: - (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Zap-ping Through Campaign ft. Cindy & Ein (CDR + RH Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Similar to CDR Variant but trades HelmTr/Naga for Red Hood, whose gigantic ATK buff might be beneficial for countering stat deficit. Red Hood also offers fast Burst gen, much faster than HelmTr if needed because she can be spammed. Substitutions: - (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Zap-ping Through Campaign ft. Cindy & Ein (Non-CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Similar to CDR Variant but trades CDR for Red Hood, whose gigantic ATK buff might be beneficial for countering stat deficit. Some stages do not require CDR, and using spawn gates/mob stalling, you can achieve much powerful damage Bursts. Substitutions: - (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Zap-ping Through Campaign ft. Rapipi & Ein (CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team is one of the best Electric stage demolishers, featuring Ein's True Damage and reliable AoE clearing as well as Rapipi's insane AoE potential, HelmTr synergizes well with Ein's lack of Core Damage and supports the team with Burst Gen (which the other 4 units lack). She also triggers Crown's S2. Substitutions: - (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Zap-ping Through Campaign ft. Rapipi & Ein (CDR + RH Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Similar to the HelmTr variant, but Naga is more accessible to new players, is free, and does not require Limit Breaks or Doll. The difference is that Naga does not buff all kinds of damage but buffs Core Damage immensely. Both still trigger Crown's S2, however. Substitutions: - (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapihelm (CDR + Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Rapipi + HelmTr have been a staple Water comp for Campaign, although they are not as prominent as the rest due to HelmTr's lack of AoE potential. However, HelmTr can provide healing and insane single-target damage that, when timed properly, can change the tides of a battle, especially against Farters. Substitutions: - (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapihelm (CDR + RH Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The Red Hood variant of the Rapi: Red Hood + HelmTr team. Substitutions: - (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapilud (CDR + Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Winter: Ludmilla Owner isn't necessarily a good AoE mobber, but she can be used in Campaign. Her ATK buff and Damage Taken can help take down a priority target in an instant during Burst. Substitutions: - (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapilud (CDR + RH Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] An alternative to the Naga variant that features Red-Hood B1 for ATK buffing. Substitutions: - (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Triple DPS (Water)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The triple DPS variant of Water comp, featuring Rapipi and HelmTr as primary B3 and XLud as off-Burst B3 and debuffer. Substitutions: - (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Clash-ing Through Campaign ft. RRH & RH
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The best and most reliable Iron clearer because RRH & RH are goated in Campaign. Does it need any more explanation? We use Naga here for Core Damage, but you can also use HelmTr for better Burst gen, healing Burst Skill (especially against Farters), and higher CP (for most players since Helm-Treasure is a top-tier Treasure priority). Higher CP negates stat penalty. Substitutions: - (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Clash-ing Through Campaign ft. RRH & Maxwell (CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Rapi: Red Hood funnel team with Maxwell's buff. Overloading Rapipi can be beneficial for some stages where one rotation (usually Rapipi's rotation) is much more significant than the other. Substitutions: - (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Clash-ing Through Campaign ft. RRH & Maxwell (CDR + RH Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Rapi: Red Hood funnel team that is slightly more balanced and flexible since RH can buff Maxwell's Burst and also B3 if needed. However, Rapipi will deal less damage. Substitutions: - (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Clash-ing Through Campaign ft. RH & Maxwell (CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Maxwell team used to be popular back in the days for one-shotting bosses. She has never become outdated, although many new DPS have outshone her. An invested Maxwell, paired with RH B1 buff and Naga's Core Damage can deal debilitating damage to an enemy. Substitutions: - (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: One-Nikke-Army-Vesgod
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] When they first dropped her, people were kinda disappointed with her Bossing power (which is the most famous mode in Nikke - Solo Raid). But eventually we figure out what a monster Shift Up has let loose onto their game. Vesgod is the one woman army. On Burst, off Burst, buffer has or not, it doesn’t matter. If loving you is the work of God, then Vesti’s work is sending you back to Him. Substitutions: -

She can even help you as a decent B1 CDR when you lack a proper team and just have her + another One Nikke Army. Disadvantage? Require your device to run at 60 FPS consistently. Substitutions: -

At this level of penalty, you can pretty much use any B1, B2 and Modernia carries everything with her sheer power alone. Substitutions: -

Example B3 can be high ranking in Tier List Substitutions: -

archetypes.name: Auto Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] At this level, this team brings a lot to the table, and unless it’s a very nasty stage where a lot of oneshot mobs are spawned, you can use this team to play automatically. It’s balanced and well-rounded with heal, offensive, buffs. Substitutions: Vesti: Tactical Upgrade, Rapi: Red Hood can be replaced with: Cinderella, the better Scarlet. Huge wipe, strong DPS, and Blanc gives her everything she wants too (HP + Damage increase). Scarlet: Black Shadow is a great choice, but when the penalty starts breathing on her neck, her clearing power is not as impressive as at lower penalty. Modernia: is clapped hard by Rapi, both in single target and AoE, but if you don’t have Rapi, Modernia is still very good. Incase you don't have Liter, of course you pick Siren here. But if you don't even have Siren. Pepper is a decent healer with high offensive power. She doesn’t reduce cooldown, but she heals a lot with her Burst. D: Killer Wife / Rouge also provide Cooldown Reduction (CDR) just like Liter, except their other buffs feel pale compared to Liter. Dorothy brings both CDR and offensive power on her own. Definitely a good alternative. Note that Dorothy is a Pilgrim so it’s not easy to roll her. N102 is your go-to when you don’t have any of the above Nikke, go N102. If you are missing Crown, you can use Tia.

archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] An auto Team variation without Liter. Substitutions: Vesti: Tactical Upgrade, Rapi: Red Hood can be replaced with: Cinderella, the better Scarlet. Huge wipe, strong DPS, and Blanc gives her everything she wants too (HP + Damage increase). Scarlet: Black Shadow is a great choice, but when the penalty starts breathing on her neck, her clearing power is not as impressive as at lower penalty. Modernia: is clapped hard by Rapi, both in single target and AoE, but if you don’t have Rapi, Modernia is still very good. Definitely a good alternative. Note that Dorothy is a Pilgrim so it’s not easy to roll her. N102 is your go-to when you don’t have any of the above Nikke, go N102. If you are missing Crown, you can use Tia.

archetypes.name: Crowntr Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team is less comfy than the team above, but they can deal way more damage. By using this team, you may want to turn off “Auto Burst” and control Burst time yourself, because these Nikkes have very impactful Bursts that need to be used at proper time to make the most out of them. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Old "God Team"
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] They used to be the most braindead team in Nikke until Blanc-Noir were released. This team has wipe, strong DPS, CDR, a shield that blocks most instant death attacks once in a while, and a nice passive heal from Rapunzel that doesn’t even require her Bursting. Rapunzel can even come in clutch with her revival Burst, saving your run from a disaster. Heavily out-classed by any other duos, but if your duos are not completely, you can go this route. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Manual Play with Lots of Clicking
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This is the traditional team pushing story. They have semi wipe with Privaty (mostly, just stun), boss killing with Alice (requires extremely high investment but she’s worth), and damage buffers with Maxwell + Liter + Privaty. Problem is, they require you to “aim” manually, and it’s not a good experience aiming those small flying Raptures from afar. Highly NOT recommended, just putting them here as a tribute to the past. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Vesgod Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Did I just say this is where most auto teams stop? Definitely not with this team. Vesti will Burst first, make her way to the boss stage then Rapi finishes it. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: T.T Stars Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Another version of Vesgod team which has a lot of heal but is vulnerable against one shot KO Raptures. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Improvised Alice Maxwell Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Updated version of old Alice Maxwell team, but this time you have super strong buffers which are Crown and Naga. You also replace Maxwell with Alice 2.0 - yeah she's named Milk. Worst part? Milk is even more difficult to play than Alice. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: God Comp #1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] To push at this level, not only you have to fully invest in these Nikkes, but also you have to rely on good Overload roll, and Elemental advantage. And of course, your own SKILLS! This is where you can brag among all other commanders how good you are, because you are pushing under a penalty that feels impossible. By the way, in this deficit, the enemy's defense will feel so high your Nikke deals very little damage, except Vesgod - she ignores all defense! In fact, if you don’t feel like running those teams below, you can just spam this team, it works. Example Gameplay: Youtube Video - Normal Stage Youtube Video - Base Defence Stage Youtube Video- Defence Stage Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: God Comp #2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team works on one concept - True damage funneling. It has zero defense which means either you kill enemies before they start dealing damage or you die. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: God Comp #3
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Okay these teams will blow your mind, not only from how you craft them, but also you will say: Is that even possible? Key Point to Note: Red Hood is the Solo Burst I Unit, and DO NOT USE RAPI: The Hood here because she will be B1 version This team can deal with stages by relying on 2, or at maximum 3 full Bursts to pass a stage. When you use Red Hood as Burst 1 only, you have an insanely high amount of attack buffs over 10s, and you can even do it twice before she goes on cooldown. It allows you to bring 2 DPS, which will a lot of times be Modernia + Nikke that matches the “Weak Element” of the Stage. Ideally, the B3 choices depend on the stage, and aren’t as easy as - this stage is Wind Weak, so I will pick Vesti: Tactical Upgrade / Scarlet: Black Shadow Huh? Why is Vesti in Wind weak? It’s because there will be a time when you face so many Raptures at once that your SBS damage is splitted too much; it deals meme damage. When that time comes, please remember praying to Vesgod and she will answer. (1145F for example). You want to study the stage step by step and see what best helps you progress from one wave to the other wave, and what the next wave requires. At times, you might need to i-frame to dodge Remnant Raptures, or hold your Burst while your Modernia kills off Raptures outside of Burst. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Elysion Best Tribe Tower Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This is the most commonly used team in Elysion tower. It has nice AoE + huge DPS from Rapi and Vesti, decent heal with Helm Treasure and very strong heal - tank for team with HP buff from Anchor. A very brain dead team, should put on auto and forget. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Tribe Tower Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Missilis Best Tribe Tower Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Thanks to Flora with her insane buffing, you can now ditch Tia and go for Flora treasure instead. And Laplace: UH also helps a lot on mob clearing. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Tribe Tower Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Tetra Tribe Tower Team #1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Tetra is special, they can form 2 different teams and each has their own advantage and disadvantage distinctively. This team is the original, featuring 2 ~ 3 heavy DPS, depending on stage. You want Anis against Electric weak stage, else just put Noir in her place and let Alice + Xlud cover the rest. This team lacks AoE power, so you may find yourself in a pickle against some stages. Substitutions: -

archetypes.name: Tetra Tribe Tower Team #2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] With the release of Crust and Bready, we can now run them together for a very decent and constant AoE blast. Bready requires Crust to trigger her Distribute Damage, else she will have no skill. Crust requires you to fast tap her 3 times from the very start to trigger her buff, else on auto she also has 0 skill. This team is such a hassle to play, but it's indeed strong. Substitutions: You can replace Xlud with Blanc for a more comfortable gameplay but weaker damage output.

archetypes.name: Pilgrims Best Tribe Tower Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This is the most familiar team in Pilgrim Tower, with high single target damage, high wipe power, high CDR. If you notice, this team has all 5 elements, so no ele shield can annoy you. Note that you may run Rapi as B1 here to unlock another slot for B3 DPS, because Rapi B1 still deals decent damage already. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Tribe Tower Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: 2 RL Instant Nuke
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The bread and butter comp in PVP. You win by flashing your enemy before they can do anything. The combination of Red Hood B1 ATK buff and Trina B2 buffs will be enough for Scarlet to kill everything. The neat part? It's still 2 RL speed (after RL shoots 2 times, you fill your Burst gauge completely) Substitutions: -

archetypes.name: Pierce Heaven
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] When using Red Hood, save her B1 to be used with her B3 and Maid Mast’s Burst at 3 stacks once a fight. Burst Maid Mast every third burst (Crown → Crown → Mast). However, there will be situations where you need Crown to go third instead for her shield. When that happens, Burst Maid Mast at 2 stacks instead (Crown → Mast → Crown). Substitutions: Anis: Star may be replaced with Little Mermaid or Rapi: Red Hood or Liter. Red Hood or Cinderella: Crystal Wave may be replaced with Rapi: Red Hood, Milk: Blooming Bunny, Laplace (Treasure), or Raven. Mast: Romantic Maid may be replaced with Naga or Privaty (Treasure) or Helm (Treasure) or Helm: Aquamarine. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Cinderella vs Ultra
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Cinderella just keeps winning and replaces Rapi: Red Hood in her funneling team. Switch Cinderella: Crystal Wave to Sniper mode for phase 1, and MG mode for phase 2. Burst Maid Mast with Cinderella as much as possible. However, there will be situations where you need Crown burst for her shield. Substitutions: Anis: Star may be replaced with Little Mermaid or Rapi: Red Hood. Cinderella: Crystal Wave may be replaced with Rapi: Red Hood. Helm (Treasure) may be replaced with Snow White: Heavy Arms. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Artillery vs Moth
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A high investment, high reward team. Snow White needs highest final ATK than the rest of the team to make sure she gets Miranda (Treasure)’s Critical Rate buff. Make sure every Snow White nuke hits the core and 2 parts. Substitutions: Zwei (Treasure) may be replaced by Miranda (Treasure). Maxwell may be replaced with Rapi: Red Hood or Cinderella: Crystal Wave if and only if Snow White still manages to get Miranda (Treasure)’s S2 Critical Rate buff. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Battle without your King
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A shielder is needed to survive the fight, which is the only reason Tia is here. Tia needs to Burst to apply shields and requires a second B1 Nikke for the team to function. Since Tia is Iron, you pretty much get the freedom of running whatever you’ve invested in, hence very beginner friendly. Burst Tia to block the slam or shockwave from Ultra. Consider starting with Liberalio burst if you are using Crown. Burst Maid Mast every third burst (Crown → Crown → Mast). Cover Anis when necessary or she will die to Kraken. Substitutions: Anis: Star may be replaced with Siren. Nayuta may be replaced with Crown. Liberalio may be replaced with Mana or Alice or Helm (Treasure). Mast: Romantic Maid may be replaced with Crown or Naga (only used with Crown). (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Missing the great swordwoman?

Crown may be replaced with Nayuta. Liberalio or Asuka: WILLE may be replaced with Snow White: Heavy Arms, or Cinderella: Crystal Wave. Mast: Romantic Maid may be replaced with Helm (Treasure), Privaty (Treasure) or Naga. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Maids vs Octopus
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] No Crown? No problem! You can still do enough damage with Maids and reach Stage 9. Since they give a lot of distributed damage buffs, SBS performs super well here. Burst Maid Mast with SBS. Substitutions: Anis: Star may be replaced with Siren. Liberalio can be replaced with Asuka: Wille, Alice, Rapi: Red Hood, Snow White: Heavy Arms, or Cinderella: Crystal Wave. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: AFK Kraken S7
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The team has it all: heals, shielding, damage and AoE (for shooting down missiles), which actually allows it to run full auto. This is made possible by Anchor: Innocent Maid storing the excess heals provided by Helm to survive the attack caused by failing the QTE (red circles). For this team to run properly it is very important that Helm is in the middle and Anchor: Innocent Maid is on the left side of Crown for burst rotations to line up. This team only works at high investments with SR collection items and high synchro level (recommended 381+) to be able to survive. Reaching Boss Stage 7 is also possible if your SBS is strong enough. Substitutions: - (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Pure Evil Team #1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Surprisingly, this is where you start relying heavily on Crown and Mast instead. Their offensive capabilities allow you to “cheese” through a lot of stages by killing enemies before they can kill you. And Crown even has a cheese mechanic that allows her to soak a lot of damage during a certain window (When she taunts, she’s immortal. Time the taunt well will reward you nicely). Still Vesti will make sure you don’t even know what a wall means. Youtube Video Notice how he timed the Crown’s taunt to avoid the instant wipe phase Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. archetypes.name: Mission Impossible Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] How is this even possible? Back when we started this guide, 45%+ seemed impossible, but then we have this Youtube Video This team builds on one basic concept: True Damage. True Damage ignores all defense, a thing which may seem underrate at surface level, but it becomes more and more evil the deeper deficit you dive. Most Nikkes deal 1 damage at 45+% Deficit, with only a few Nikkes who can still deal some damages due to high ATK amount self buff. Vesti is the main damage dealer, with Ada acts as both buffers and semi damage dealer. Takina also buffs a lot for true damage DPS. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

synergyPairs.reason: 메이드 듀오. 무조건부 공격버프 + 힐 + 재장전 속도 증가로 탄약 관리 부담을 없애줌.

버스트II 2인 콤보로 커뮤니티에서 잘 알려진 조합. 크라운의 버스트 쿨타임(20초)이 항상 먼저 준비되기 때문에 오토에 맡기면 크라운만 계속 버스트를 쓰고 마스트의 버스트(강력한 공격버프)는 거의 발동하지 않는다 — 크라운 버스트 직후 곧바로 마스트 버스트를 수동으로 눌러줘야 실제로 발동한다. 마스트는 이 조합이 없어도 1/2스킬 버프만으로 이미 훌륭하므로 필수 조합은 아니며, 수동 버스트 조작이 가능한 유저에게 추천되는 강화 픽이다.
강력한 버프를 주고받지만 두 캐릭터가 세트로 있어야 성능이 나오는 경직적 페어.
딜러를 크게 가리지 않는 범용 버스트I+II 코어. 주의: 크라운을 보유하고 있다면 크라운이 이 페어의 상위호환이므로 크라운을 대신 채택하고 이 페어(특히 티아)는 제외할 것 — 크라운이 버스트II를 가져가면 나가는 토템으로 전환되어 이 페어의 전제(둘 다 실제 버스트를 발동하는 코어)가 깨진다.
즈바이 트레저의 크리티컬 부족을 민트가 정확히 메꿔줌.
델타의 받는피해 증가 디버프가 크라운 S2 반복 발동을 도움.
전기/철 속성 보스전 핵심 지원 페어.
나가의 코어뎀 버프는 코어뎀 스케일링 딜러(신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브)에만 유의미.
고정 데미지 버프를 주고받는 상호의존 듀오, PvP 순간딜 특화.
라피의 화력에 헬름 트레저의 버스트 생성/힐이 더해지는 표준 화력조합 페어.
레드후드B1의 공격버프가 홍련의 순삭형 버스트 데미지를 극대화.
맥스웰의 지속 공격버프가 라피 같은 하이퍼캐리 딜러와 잘 맞음.
맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉의 최대체력 버프가 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로의 생존력을 보강해 PVP 폭딜 타이밍을 확보해주는 조합. 국내 유튜버(스페란도)가 루주·트리나와 함께 반복 소개(2026-07-31 기준, 후속 확인 필요).
